params.swapExecutor_: Address of the initial ISwapExecutor implementation.

executeDecision(uint256,(uint8,uint256,u.details: This is the primary entry point for Module 6.      Validates the DecisionResult against live on-chain state,      withdraws exact capital from the YieldVault,      invokes the swap executor, and records accounting.      Authorization: Only the strategy owner or an authorized executor may call.      Replay protection: The caller must supply the expected execution nonce.      Stale-decision protection: The DecisionResult.timestamp must be recent.

params.decision: The DecisionResult produced by the DecisionEngine for this strategy.
params.expectedNonce: The caller's expected execution nonce (prevents replay).
params.minSwapOutput: Minimum acceptable swap output amount (0 to disable slippage check).
params.strategyId: Unique ID of the DCA strategy to execute.

getExecutionNonce(uint256).details: The next executeDecision call must supply this value as expectedNonce.

getRemainingAllocation(uint256).details: remainingAllocation = targetAllocation - totalExecuted.      Returns targetAllocation if strategy has never been executed.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setStrategyExecutor(uint256,address,bool.details: Only callable by the strategy owner.

params.authorized: True to authorize, false to revoke.

params.newExecutor: Address of the new ISwapExecutor implementation.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

DEFAULT_MAX_DECISION_AGE().notice: Default maximum accepted age of a DecisionResult (5 minutes).

dcaEngine().notice: Reference to Module 1: DCA Strategy Engine.

executeDecision(uint256,(uint8,uint256,u.notice: Executes or processes a decision produced by Module 5's DecisionEngine.

getExecutionNonce(uint256).notice: Returns the current execution nonce for a strategy.

getExecutionRecord(uint256).notice: Returns the execution accounting record for a strategy.

getRemainingAllocation(uint256).notice: Returns the remaining target allocation for a strategy.

isAuthorizedExecutor(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether an address is authorized to execute a given strategy.

maxDecisionAge().notice: Returns the maximum age in seconds a DecisionResult remains valid.

setMaxDecisionAge(uint256).notice: Updates the maximum accepted age of a DecisionResult. Only callable by owner.

setStrategyExecutor(uint256,address,bool.notice: Authorizes or revokes an automation executor address per strategy.

setSwapExecutor(address).notice: Updates the swap executor. Only callable by owner.

swapExecutor().notice: Returns the address of the current swap executor.

yieldVault().notice: Reference to Module 2: ERC-4626 Yield Vault.
